claims.text: Pin-like joints can be valid for ideal trusses, so Fraia should diagnose release patterns against intended system behaviour rather than treating all pins as errors.

limitations: Introductory determinacy formulas do not cover all 3D finite-element, constraint, diaphragm, or nonlinear support cases.
Mechanism diagnosis must use resolved topology, supports, releases, and constraints, not visual geometry alone.
